edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside mintBAI via _safeMint.
mintBAIByOwner is gated by onlyOwner, so msg.sender must equal owner().
withdraw transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
changeBaseURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
setProvenanceHash is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
msg.sender is forwarded as the operator argument to onERC721Received.
The ETH transfer target in withdraw is msg.sender.
BAI_SUPPLY bounds the totalSupply guard in getBAIPrice.
BAI_SUPPLY caps the mintable amount in mintBAI.
BAI_SUPPLY caps the mintable amount in mintBAIByOwner.
SALE_START_BLOCK anchors every price tier comparison in getBAIPrice.
SALE_REVEAL_BLOCK is derived from SALE_START_BLOCK.
BLOCKS_PER_HOUR is part of the SALE_REVEAL_BLOCK computation.
BLOCKS_PER_HOUR scales each price tier boundary in getBAIPrice.
SALE_REVEAL_BLOCK bounds the mint window inside mintBAI.
startingIndexBlock is written by mintBAI once the sale ends.
startingIndexBlock is used as the blockhash seed in finalizeStartingIndex.
startingIndex is both guarded and assigned inside finalizeStartingIndex.
_mintedBeforeReveal is written during mintBAI for pre-reveal mints.
isMintedBeforeReveal reads from the _mintedBeforeReveal mapping.
getBAIPrice result is multiplied by requestedAmount to validate msg.value.
mintBAI mints each token through _safeMint.
mintBAIByOwner mints each token through _safeMint.
_safeMint performs the actual mint by calling _mint.
_safeMint triggers the receiver callback through _checkOnERC721Received.
_checkOnERC721Received makes an external call to an arbitrary receiver.
withdraw executes the low-level ETH transfer to the caller.
mintBAI uses SafeMath add/mul to bound supply and validate payment.
requestedAmount drives the supply and payment arithmetic in mintBAI.
Loop counter i controls the batch mint loop in mintBAI.
mintIndex is derived from totalSupply inside the mintBAI loop.
requestedAmount drives the supply arithmetic in mintBAIByOwner.
Loop counter i controls the batch mint loop in mintBAIByOwner.
mintIndex is derived from totalSupply inside the mintBAIByOwner loop.
Local balance is read and then transferred out in withdraw.
baseURI parameter is passed to _setBaseURI in changeBaseURI.
provenanceHash parameter is stored into BAI_PROVENANCE.
index parameter indexes the _mintedBeforeReveal mapping.
currentBlockNumber is used to select the price tier in getBAIPrice.
to parameter designates the mint recipient in _safeMint.
tokenId parameter designates the token minted by _safeMint.
_data parameter is forwarded to the receiver callback by _safeMint.
to parameter designates the mint recipient in _mint.
tokenId parameter designates the token minted by _mint.
from parameter is forwarded to the receiver callback.
to parameter is the address that is externally called.
tokenId parameter is forwarded to the receiver callback.
_data parameter is forwarded unchanged to the receiver callback.
